note: English Islamic wisdom pool, written from the author's own knowledge (no printed source was copied); Quran lines are paraphrased meanings, hadith lines are paraphrases attributed only to the collection; reflections are original. Not a scholarly translation; scholarly review advised.

items.text: All praise is for Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
Guide us to the straight path.
Seek help through patience and prayer.
Remember Me, and I will remember you. Be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
When My servants ask you about Me, I am near. I answer the call of the caller when he calls on Me.
Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
Perhaps you dislike something that is good for you, and perhaps you love something that is bad for you. Allah knows, and you do not know.
Do good. Indeed, Allah loves those who do good.
Whatever good you send ahead for yourselves, you will find it with Allah.
Each has a direction to turn to. So compete with one another in good deeds.
O you who believe, enter into peace completely, and do not follow the footsteps of Satan.
There is no compulsion in religion.
A kind word and forgiveness are better than charity followed by hurt.
If you give charity openly, it is good. If you give it quietly to the poor, it is better for you.
Those who spend their wealth by night and by day, secretly and openly, will have their reward with their Lord.
We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final return.
Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Our Lord, do not let our hearts go astray after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself.
You will never attain righteousness until you spend from what you love.
Hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together, and do not be divided.
Hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and to a Garden as wide as the heavens and the earth.
Those who spend in ease and in hardship, who restrain their anger and pardon people. Allah loves the doers of good.
Do not weaken and do not grieve, for you will be superior if you are believers.
Our Lord, forgive our sins and our excesses, make our feet firm, and help us over the disbelieving people.
Because of Allah's mercy you were gentle with them. Had you been harsh and hard-hearted, they would have left you. When you have decided, rely on Allah.
Allah is enough for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
Every soul will taste death.
O you who believe, be patient, outlast in patience, stand ready, and fear Allah, so that you may succeed.
Allah wants to lighten your burden, for man was created weak.
Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and be good to parents, relatives, orphans and the poor.
Allah commands you to return trusts to their owners, and when you judge between people, to judge with justice.
Prayer is prescribed for the believers at fixed times.
O you who believe, stand firmly for justice, as witnesses for Allah, even against yourselves.
Help one another in righteousness and piety, and do not help one another in sin and aggression.
Be just. That is closer to piety.
Whoever saves one life, it is as if he saved all of mankind.
O you who believe, fear Allah, seek the means of nearness to Him, and strive in His cause, so that you may succeed.
Whoever brings a good deed will have ten times the like of it.
Say: my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.
Eat and drink, but do not be excessive. Allah does not love the excessive.
Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to those who do good.
Our Lord, pour patience upon us and take us in death as Muslims.
My mercy encompasses all things.
Hold to forgiveness, command what is right, and turn away from the ignorant.
The believers are those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, and whose faith grows when His verses are recited to them.
Do not grieve. Indeed, Allah is with us.
Nothing will befall us except what Allah has decreed for us. He is our protector, and in Allah let the believers put their trust.
O you who believe, fear Allah and be with the truthful.
Indeed, the friends of Allah have no fear, nor will they grieve.
If Allah touches you with hardship, none can remove it except Him.
My success is only through Allah. In Him I trust, and to Him I turn.
Establish prayer at the two ends of the day and in the early part of the night. Good deeds wipe out bad deeds.
Be patient, for Allah does not let the reward of the doers of good be lost.
I only complain of my sorrow and my grief to Allah.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
Whoever fears Allah and is patient, Allah does not let the reward of the good-doers be lost.
You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Let me die as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is within themselves.
Surely, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
If you are grateful, I will surely give you more.
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and my descendants too. Our Lord, accept my prayer.
Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.
Worship your Lord until certainty comes to you.
Allah commands justice, excellence, and giving to relatives, and forbids indecency, wrongdoing and oppression.
Whoever does righteousness, male or female, while a believer, We will give them a good life.
Call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in the best way.
Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who do good.
Your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him and that you be kind to your parents.
Lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy, and say: my Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
Do not follow what you have no knowledge of. Hearing, sight and the heart will all be questioned.
Do not walk on the earth arrogantly.
Tell My servants to say what is best.
We have honored the children of Adam.
My Lord, make my entrance truthful and my exit truthful, and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and prepare for us right guidance in our affair.
Never say of anything: I will do that tomorrow, except: if Allah wills.
It is what Allah has willed. There is no power except with Allah.
Wealth and children are the adornment of this worldly life, but the lasting good deeds are better with your Lord in reward and in hope.
Whoever hopes to meet his Lord, let him do righteous deeds and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord.
My Lord, expand my chest for me, and ease my task for me.
Do not fear. I am with you both, hearing and seeing.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
Command your family to pray and be steadfast in it.
Adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.
There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.
We have not sent you except as a mercy to all the worlds.
Bow down, prostrate, worship your Lord and do good, so that you may succeed.
Successful indeed are the believers, who are humble in their prayers.
My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful.
Let them pardon and overlook. Do you not love that Allah should forgive you?
The servants of the Most Merciful walk on the earth humbly, and when the ignorant address them, they say: peace.
Our Lord, grant us comfort in our spouses and offspring, and make us leaders of the righteous.
My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous.
My Lord, enable me to be thankful for Your favor which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do righteous deeds that please You.
This is from the favor of my Lord, to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful.
My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
Seek, through what Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter, and do not forget your share of this world. Do good as Allah has done good to you.
Do people think they will be left alone because they say: we believe, and will not be tested?
Prayer keeps one away from shameful and wrong deeds, and the remembrance of Allah is greater.
Those who strive for Us, We will surely guide them to Our ways.
Among His signs is that He created for you spouses to find comfort in, and placed between you love and mercy.
My son, do not associate anything with Allah. Associating others with Him is a great wrong.
Be grateful to Me and to your parents. To Me is the final return.
My son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you.
Do not turn your cheek away from people in contempt, and do not walk on the earth arrogantly.
Be moderate in your pace and lower your voice.
O you who believe, remember Allah often.
O you who believe, fear Allah and speak words of truth.
To Him ascend good words, and righteous deeds raise them.
Say: are those who know equal to those who do not know?
Only the patient will be given their reward without measure.
Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.
I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is watchful over His servants.
Call upon Me and I will respond to you.
Repel evil with what is better, and the one between whom and you there was enmity will become like a close friend.
The reward for a bad deed is a bad deed like it, but whoever pardons and makes peace, his reward is with Allah.
Whoever is patient and forgives, that is among the matters of firm resolve.
My Lord, enable me to be grateful for the favor You have given me and my parents.
If you support Allah, He will support you and make your feet firm.
The believers are but brothers, so make peace between your brothers.
O you who believe, let no people ridicule another people, who may be better than them.
Avoid much suspicion. Do not spy on one another, and do not backbite.
We made you into peoples and tribes so that you may know one another. The most honored of you with Allah is the most righteous.
We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
Remind, for reminding benefits the believers.
I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
Man will have nothing except what he strives for.
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Is the reward for good anything but good?
He is with you wherever you are.
Has the time not come for the hearts of the believers to humble themselves at the remembrance of Allah?
So that you do not grieve over what you missed, nor exult over what He has given you.
Allah will raise those who believe among you, and those who were given knowledge, in degrees.
They prefer others over themselves, even though they are in need.
Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who came before us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any resentment toward those who believe.
O you who believe, fear Allah, and let every soul look to what it has sent ahead for tomorrow.
When the prayer is finished, disperse in the land, seek the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often.
Do not let your wealth and your children distract you from the remembrance of Allah.
No disaster strikes except by Allah's permission. Whoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart.
Fear Allah as much as you are able, listen, obey, and spend in charity. That is better for you.
If you lend Allah a good loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you.
Whoever fears Allah, He will make a way out for him.
He will provide for him from where he does not expect. Whoever relies on Allah, He is enough for him.
Allah does not burden a soul beyond what He has given it. After hardship, Allah will bring ease.
He created death and life to test which of you is best in deeds.
Remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him completely.
We feed you only for the face of Allah. We want no reward or thanks from you.
Successful is the one who purifies himself, remembers the name of his Lord and prays.
O tranquil soul, return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing to Him.
Your Lord has not abandoned you, nor has He become displeased.
What is to come will be better for you than what has passed.
As for the orphan, do not oppress him. As for the one who asks, do not repel him.
As for the favor of your Lord, speak of it.
For indeed, with hardship comes ease.
Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
When you have finished, then strive, and turn to your Lord in longing.
Read in the name of your Lord who created.
Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.
By time, mankind is in loss, except those who believe, do good, advise one another to truth and advise one another to patience.
Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor was begotten, and there is nothing comparable to Him.
Surely we belong to Allah, and to Him we shall return.
Allah loves those who turn to Him in repentance and those who keep themselves clean.
Guard the prayers, especially the middle prayer, and stand before Allah in devotion.
Allah. There is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.
Say: if you love Allah, follow me, and Allah will love you and forgive your sins.
If Allah helps you, none can overcome you.
Those who remember Allah standing, sitting and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth.
When you are greeted with a greeting, answer with a better one, or at least return it.
Allah does not want to place any burden on you, but He wants to purify you and complete His favor upon you.
Your Lord has decreed mercy upon Himself.
Remember your Lord within yourself, humbly and in awe, in the morning and in the evening, and do not be among the heedless.
Be patient. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
For those who do good is the best reward, and more.
O mankind, there has come to you a lesson from your Lord, a healing for what is in the hearts, and guidance and mercy for the believers.
There is no creature on earth but its provision is with Allah.
The soul commands evil, except where my Lord shows mercy.
It is We who sent down the Reminder, and We will surely guard it.
If you tried to count Allah's blessings, you could not number them.
Whatever blessing you have is from Allah.
This Quran guides to what is most upright.
We send down in the Quran what is a healing and a mercy for the believers.
Keep yourself patient with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His face.
Those who believe and do good, the Most Merciful will give them love.
I am Most Forgiving to those who repent, believe and do good, and then stay on the right path.
It is not the eyes that go blind, but the hearts within the chests.
Repel evil with what is better.
When I am ill, it is He who heals me.
You cannot guide whomever you like, but Allah guides whom He wills.
Be patient. The promise of Allah is true.
They rise from their beds to call on their Lord in fear and hope, and spend from what We have given them.
Whatever you spend, He will replace it, and He is the best of providers.
Only those of His servants who have knowledge truly fear Allah.
Is Allah not enough for His servant?
Those who say "Our Lord is Allah" and then stay steady, the angels descend upon them: do not fear and do not grieve.
Allah is kind to His servants.
He is the One who sent calm into the hearts of the believers.
If a wrongdoer brings you news, verify it, so that you do not harm people out of ignorance.
In their wealth there was a rightful share for the beggar and the deprived.
We have made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who will take heed?
Everyone on earth will perish, and the Face of your Lord will remain, full of majesty and honor.
The life of this world is only play, amusement, show and boasting among you.
O you who believe, why do you say what you do not do?
O you who believe, turn to Allah in sincere repentance.
Indeed, you are of a great character.
As for the one who feared standing before his Lord and held back his soul from desire, Paradise will be his home.
The one who purifies his soul has succeeded.
Your Lord will give you, and you will be pleased.
You have your way, and I have mine.
Glorify your Lord with praise and ask His forgiveness. He is always accepting of repentance.
Actions are judged by intentions, and everyone will have what they intended.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or stay silent.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honour his guest.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbour.
The strong person is not the one who wins at wrestling, but the one who controls himself in anger.
A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.
The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
Make things easy and do not make them hard. Give good news and do not drive people away.
Allah does not show mercy to those who show no mercy to people.
Two blessings are often wasted by people: health and free time.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveller.
The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if they are small.
Richness is not having many possessions. Richness is the richness of the soul.
Whoever is not thankful to people is not thankful to Allah.
The one who joins family ties is not the one who only returns a favour, but the one who joins them when they are cut off.
There is a piece of flesh in the body. If it is sound, the whole body is sound. If it is corrupt, the whole body is corrupt. It is the heart.
Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most untrue of speech.
Do not be angry.
The best of you are those with the best character.
The upper hand is better than the lower hand.
He who is not merciful to our young and does not respect our elders is not one of us.
Whoever gives water to a thirsty person, Allah will give him to drink from the sealed nectar of Paradise.
A word of truth in front of an unjust ruler is among the best forms of striving.
Every act of kindness is charity.
Truthfulness leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Paradise.
Lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire.
Whoever shows the way to something good has a reward like the one who does it.
Religion is sincerity: to Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.
Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
Purity is half of faith. Saying "Alhamdulillah" fills the scale.
Wonderful is the affair of the believer: all of it is good. If good comes, he is grateful, and if hardship comes, he is patient.
Charity does not decrease wealth.
Allah increases a servant in honour when he forgives.
Whoever humbles himself for Allah, Allah raises him.
Do not envy one another, do not inflate prices against each other, do not hate one another, and be servants of Allah as brothers.
The believer is strong, and the strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and there is good in both.
Be keen on what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not give up.
When a person dies, his deeds end except for three: ongoing charity, knowledge that benefits, and a righteous child who prays for him.
Whoever follows a path to seek knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and the Fire is surrounded by desires.
Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
Whoever conceals the faults of a Muslim, Allah will conceal his faults in this world and the next.
Hasten to do good deeds before trials come like pieces of a dark night.
The best charity is that given while you are healthy and hold on to your wealth.
Modesty brings nothing but good.
Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good one and it will wipe it out, and treat people with good character.
The most complete believers in faith are those with the best character.
Nothing is heavier on the scale of the believer on the Day of Resurrection than good character.
Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
A person's Islam is made good by leaving what does not concern him.
The clever person is the one who holds himself to account and works for what comes after death.
The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth and the One in heaven will be merciful to you.
The prayer of a person for his brother in his absence is answered.
Whoever is slow in his deeds will not be sped up by his lineage.
Charity extinguishes sin as water extinguishes fire.
The best of companions to Allah is the best to his companion, and the best of neighbours is the best to his neighbour.
The believer is not a slanderer, does not curse, is not obscene and is not foul-mouthed.
Whoever is given gentleness has been given a share of good.
The best of you are the best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.
Whoever is concerned with the Hereafter, Allah makes his heart rich and gathers his affairs for him.
Truthful and trustworthy merchants will be with the prophets, the truthful and the martyrs.
The believers in their mutual love, mercy and compassion are like one body.
Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him in front of you.
If you ask, ask Allah. If you seek help, seek help from Allah.
The Muslim who gives a garment to another Muslim, Allah will clothe him from the green garments of Paradise.
Allah has revealed to me that you should be humble, so that none of you boasts over another.
Pray as you have seen me pray.
Allah is pleased with a servant who eats and thanks Him for it, and drinks and thanks Him for it.
Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah will build for him a house in Paradise.
Whoever prays Fajr is under the protection of Allah.
Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and hope for reward will have his past sins forgiven.
Fasting is a shield. Whoever is fasting should not speak foolishly or shout. If someone insults him, let him say, "I am fasting."
When Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of Hell are closed.
Whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr with faith and hope for reward will have his past sins forgiven.
The fasting person has two joys: when he breaks his fast, and when he meets his Lord.
Hasten to give charity, for a time will come when a person will look for someone to take it.
Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted for a lifetime.
Take suhoor, for there is a blessing in the pre-dawn meal.
Hasten to break the fast. People will remain in good as long as they hasten to break it.
Whoever feeds a fasting person will have the same reward as the one who fasted.
There are three whose dua is not rejected: the fasting person until he breaks his fast, the just ruler, and the oppressed one.
Whoever relieves a believer's distress, Allah will relieve his distress on the Day of Resurrection.
A man who gives charity so quietly that his left hand does not know what his right hand gave will be shaded by Allah on the Day when there is no shade but His.
The believer to another believer is like a building whose parts support each other.
The Muslim is a brother of the Muslim. He does not wrong him or abandon him.
A good word is charity.
Whoever plants a tree or sows a field, and a person or animal eats from it, it counts as charity for him.
When one of you sees something wrong, let him change it with his hand. If he cannot, then with his tongue. If he cannot, then with his heart.
Allah has divided mercy into one hundred parts. He kept ninety-nine with Him and sent down one on earth, and that is why creatures show mercy to each other.
The most beloved names to Allah are Abdullah and Abdur-Rahman.
Verily, Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him keep good ties with his relatives.
Every one of you is a shepherd and every one of you is responsible for his flock.
You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Spread peace among yourselves.
The best Islam is to feed others and to greet those you know and those you do not know with peace.
Whoever says "SubhanAllah wa bihamdihi" a hundred times in a day, his sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.
Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale and beloved to the Most Merciful: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil Azim.
Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than one of you who finds his lost camel in the desert.
Every child is born upon the natural disposition, and then his parents make him a Jew, a Christian or a Magian.
Beware of injustice, for injustice will be darkness on the Day of Resurrection.
The one who looks after a widow or a poor person is like one who strives in the way of Allah.
Your mother, then your mother, then your mother, then your father, then the one next closest.
Look at those below you and not at those above you, for that is a better way not to belittle the favours of Allah.
Whoever has the hope of meeting Allah, Allah loves to meet him.
Allah says: I am as My servant expects Me to be, and I am with him when he remembers Me.
When Allah loves a servant, He calls Gabriel and says, "I love so and so, so love him."
The hearts of the children of Adam are between two fingers of the Most Merciful, as one heart. He turns it as He wills.
Prayer is light.
The world is sweet and green, and Allah has placed you as successors in it to see how you act.
Hold yourselves to account before you are held to account.
May Allah have mercy on the one who shows me my faults.
Knowledge is better than wealth: knowledge guards you, and you have to guard wealth.
items.ref: Attributed to Ali ibn Abi Talib

items.text: The value of each person is what he does well.
items.ref: Attributed to Ali ibn Abi Talib

items.text: Son of Adam, you are only a number of days. When a day goes, a part of you goes.
Knowledge is not what is memorised. Knowledge is what benefits.
Begin with the intention before the deed. Many a small deed is made great by the intention, and many a great deed is made small by it.
A small good deed done every day is worth more than a big one done once and then forgotten.
Gratitude turns what you have into enough.
Patience is not silence. It is trusting that Allah's timing is better than yours.
A heart that remembers Allah is never fully alone.
Do not wait for perfect conditions to start doing good. Start with what is in your hand today.
The prayer is a daily appointment. Do not be late for it.
Every sunrise is a new page. Write something worth reading.
Kind words cost nothing and can change someone's whole day.
When you forgive, you free your own heart first.
Ease often arrives in the moment you stop thinking it will never come.
Ask Allah for what you need, and also for what you cannot name.
Time is the one thing you cannot save. You can only spend it well or lose it.
A sincere "Alhamdulillah" in hard times is a quiet act of strength.
The best way to calm anxiety is to remember that you are not the one running the universe.
Say "Bismillah" before you begin. It changes what the work is for.
Do the right thing even when nobody will ever know.
Your intention is the first thing Allah looks at. Keep it clean.
Do not measure your worth by how busy you are. Measure it by how close you are to Allah.
Small sins repeated can weigh as much as big ones. Small repentance repeated can lift as much.
A good character is a kind of worship that everyone around you can feel.
Remember that every hardship is also a chance to be rewarded.
Be gentle with people. Most of them are fighting something you cannot see.
When you feel lost, pray two rakahs and speak to Allah in your own words.
Never think a dua was unheard. Sometimes the answer is a delay, and sometimes it is something better.
Speak less, listen more, and think before you answer.
Do not let the news of the world steal the peace of your heart.
Leave a place cleaner than you found it. That is part of faith.
A neighbour's comfort is part of your own duty.
Wealth is a trust. Ask yourself how it can be used for good.
When you help someone in secret, the reward is kept for you with Allah.
Begin the day by thanking Allah that you woke up. Many did not.
End the day by asking forgiveness. It clears the heart before sleep.
Knowledge without action is like a tree without fruit.
Learn something new about your faith every week.
Hurry toward good. Take your time with anger.
Truthfulness may cost you something today, but it protects you for years.
Remember death often. It makes the small worries small.
Make your home a place where the Quran is heard.
Your parents' prayers for you are a protection you do not always see.
A gentle correction given in private is a gift. A harsh one in public is a wound.
Make dua for others by name. The angels say the same for you.
Do not envy what Allah gave someone else. He has prepared something for you too.
The one who forgives is stronger than the one who takes revenge.
Prayer is the pause that puts the day back in order.
Let your tongue be moist with the remembrance of Allah.
Fear of Allah is not a heavy burden. It is what keeps a person safe.
The best time to repent is the moment you realise you need to.
Every day, give something: a smile, a coin, a kind word, or an hour of help.
Trust Allah, then do your part with full effort.
A short dua with a present heart is better than a long one with a wandering mind.
If you cannot do much, do a little with love.
Do not delay your prayer until you feel ready. Praying is how you become ready.
When someone speaks badly of you, remember that Allah knows the truth.
What is meant for you will not pass you by.
Be quick to say sorry and slow to hold a grudge.
Silence can be wise. So can a few well-chosen words.
Do not confuse being busy with being productive. Do what matters first.
Make the Quran a daily habit, even if it is one page.
Friends are a mirror. Choose the ones who remind you of Allah.
Honesty in small things builds the trust that matters in big ones.
Success is not only what you reach, but who you became on the way.
Share your food. It makes the meal blessed and the heart light.
Let your anger pass before you act. You will thank yourself later.
Your body is a trust. Care for it, and use it for good.
Do not be harsh with yourself when you slip. Get up, repent and carry on.
Beauty in worship is in consistency, not in how loud it looks.
Be the person who makes it easier for others to do good.
Do not underestimate a single sincere sujood.
The mosque is a place for the heart as much as for the body.
When you feel small, remember that the Lord of the worlds listens to you.
Take a moment to look at the sky today. It is a sign, too.
The present moment is the only one in which you can obey Allah.
Do not postpone repentance until tomorrow. Tomorrow is not promised.
The poor person who is content is richer than the rich person who always wants more.
Treat every guest as a blessing, and every day as a guest.
If you want peace, give peace first.
Ask yourself each night: what did I do today for Allah, for others, and for myself?
A good friend corrects you with kindness and prays for you in secret.
